title: A WKB-based fixed-grid method for capturing trait concentration in a dispersal evolution model
summary: The evolution of dispersal traits is a fundamental topic in evolutionary ecology, where natural selection may drive the trait distribution toward concentration in the rare-mutation regime. This singular behavior poses a serious numerical difficulty, since direct discretizations of the population density require very fine trait grids to identify the fittest trait and to resolve the concentrated profile accurately.
